ANTIBIOTIC GUIDELINES FOR COMMON PAEDIATRIC ILLNESSES 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
NEONATAL SEPSIS 
 
1st line 
•
Penicillin G  
100 000 MU/kg/dose  12 hourly IV 
and 
•
Gentamycin 
5 mg/kg/day 
 
once daily IV 
 
2nd line 
•
Ceftriaxone  
50-100 mg/kg/day 
8 hourly IV 
or 
•
Cefotaxime  
50-100 mg/kg/day 
8 hourly IV 
(ClaforanÒ) 
 
 
and 
•
Amikacin 
10 mg/kg/day  
once daily IV 
 
3rd line 
•
Meropenem 
20-40 mg/kg 
 
8 hourly IV 
or 
•
Tazocin  
100 mg/kg/day  
8 hourly IV 
and 
•
Amikacin 
15 mg/kg  
 
loading dose IV 
10 mg/kg/day  
once daily IV 
 
RESPIRATORY INFECTIONS 
 
Outpatient 
•
Amoxicillin 
30 mg/kg/dose  
8 hourly PO 
 
Inpatient 1st line 
•
Ampicillin 
100 mg/kg/day  
6 hourly IV 
(25 mg/kg/dose) 
 
 
 
If severe infection also add 
 
•
Gentamycin 
5mg /kg/day 
 
once daily IV 
 
If PCP is suspected start 
 
•
Bactrim  
30 mg/kg/dose  
6 hourly IV 
 
BACTERIAL MENINGITIS 
 
> 1 MONTH 
•
Ceftriaxone 
80-100 mg/kg/day 
once daily IV 
(preferably after LP) 
 
< 1 MONTH 
•
Cefotaxime  
100 mg/kg/day  
8 hourly IV 
Dr R Gihwala CMJAH Emergency Department June 2020
